_meta.note: 各社公式の禁制品ページからの転記。記載がないマスは level:'unknown' とし、ok に丸めない。quoteEn は公式原文の抜粋。

levels.ok: 公式に扱えると読める、または禁制品リストに該当がなく他社の記載とも矛盾しない
levels.conditional: 扱えるが条件付き（部品の廃棄、開封検品、追加料金など）
levels.carrier_limited: 特定の配送手段でのみ可。本ツールはEMSのみ扱うため、EMS不可なら実質prohibited
levels.unknown: 公式ページに記載が見当たらない。okに丸めず警告を出す

_meta.carrierScope: 本ツールの国際配送はEMS（日本郵便）のみ。DHL/FedEx/UPS限定で可の項目はEMS基準ではprohibited扱いになる。

attributes.helpEn: Model paint, lacquer thinner, nail polish, perfume, alcohol-based liquids
attributes.whenBlockedEn: No proxy and no Japanese shop can put this on a plane — it is an air transport rule, not a company policy. Buy the same paint from a hobby retailer in your own country; Mr. Hobby, Tamiya and Gaia Notes are all distributed internationally.

attributes.helpEn: Spray paint, matte topcoat, air duster, spray deodorant
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Pressurised cans cannot fly, so no proxy or Japanese store can send one. Buy the spray locally and import only the parts that are not aerosols.

attributes.helpEn: LED or sound figures, handheld consoles, electronics, power banks
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Japan Post will not carry it on this route, but DHL, FedEx and UPS still can. ZenMarket and Neokyo both offer courier shipping — the price will be higher than the EMS figures on this page. Loose batteries and power banks are refused by every route.
attributes.whenUnconfirmedEn: Japan Post does carry lithium batteries to this destination, but only when the battery is already installed in the device, and the proxies cap it at two per parcel. Loose cells and power banks are refused on every route. With a service that publishes no rule of its own, the decision is made at the warehouse after you have paid.

attributes.helpEn: Anything shaped like a real firearm, including toys
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Buyee and Neokyo refuse airsoft and model guns outright. ZenMarket does not ban them, but publishes a handling procedure instead — any cartridges are destroyed on arrival and the package is opened for inspection, with disposal and handling fees on top. Before you bid, check that your own country allows the import: in Victoria, Queensland, South Australia and Tasmania, owning one is illegal regardless of how it was shipped.

attributes.helpEn: Zippo and other lighters, refill gas, matches
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Lighters and lighter fuel cannot be carried by air. If it is a collectible Zippo, look for the same design from a seller already located in your country.

attributes.helpEn: Character snacks, prize sweets, instant food, tea
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Where a proxy blocks food it is usually the destination country refusing it, not the proxy. Check your own customs rules before buying.

attributes.helpEn: Doujinshi, games and goods with adult content
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Where this is blocked it is the destination country refusing it at customs. The parcel is seized, not returned, so the loss is total.
Blades are refused by most proxies regardless of destination. A licensed importer in your own country is the realistic route for an iaito or replica katana.

attributes.helpEn: Perfume, cologne, body mist, aroma oil
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Perfume contains alcohol and counts as a flammable liquid on air routes, so none of these services will send it. The way left is a shop that ships perfume abroad itself; ask the shop how it sends it before you order.

attributes.helpEn: Lotions, creams, masks and make-up (not sprays, nail polish or perfume)
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Where cosmetics are refused it is usually because of a flammable warning on the label, sunscreen, or a high alcohol content. Check the label before you buy, and ask the service about anything with alcohol near the top of the ingredients.

attributes.helpEn: Medicine sold without a prescription in Japan
attributes.whenBlockedEn: Your own country also limits medicine sent by post, often to a personal quantity, and some need a prescription. Check your customs rules before buying, whichever service you use.
No service here will send plants or seeds. Plants and seeds also face quarantine rules at the border in most countries, so the realistic route is a seller in your own country.

flammable_liquid.quoteEn: Oil Paints / Nail Polish / Alcohol / Paint Thinner / Paints / Lacquer / Perfume

aerosol.quoteEn: Aerosol Spray Cans / Dust Remover Spray. "The amount of arriving aerosol spray cans have increased in recent period; however, this kind of items are considered dangerous that cannot be shipped out."

lithium_battery.noteEn: That is the only battery entry in Buyee's all-country prohibited list; lithium batteries are not mentioned either way. Japan Post rules still apply — see the destination check.

replica_gun.quoteEn: Airguns / Gas Gun / Gun Parts(Metal) / Ammunition

lighter.quoteEn: Lighters / Oil Lighters / Lighter Fuel / Butane Lighter Fuel / Matches

food.noteEn: Food is not named anywhere in Buyee's all-country prohibited list. Buyee points to the destination country's own rules instead of publishing a food policy of its own.

adult.noteEn: "Obscene Articles" is listed as prohibited, but Buyee does not define where ordinary R18 doujinshi falls. Judged case by case at the warehouse.

perfume.noteEn: Listed among the items Buyee cannot send to any country.

cosmetics.noteEn: Buyee's all-country list names hair dye, nail polish, perfume and alcohol, but says nothing about skincare or make-up in general.

medicine.noteEn: Buyee's list names narcotics, psychoactive drugs and pharmaceuticals containing blood, but not ordinary medicine.

plants_seeds.noteEn: Buyee's all-country list names living beings and soil. It does not name seeds separately.

flammable_liquid.quoteEn: Any flammable liquids (Gasoline, oil, alcohol, other) ... Other examples of products that cannot be shipped are: lighters, lighter liquids, dry Fuel Tablets, flammable paint

aerosol.quoteEn: Any sprays or otherwise condensed air, gases ... deodorant sprays, aroma-sprays

lithium_battery.quoteEn: If shipping with EMS, Airmail, no more than 2 li-ion batteries per parcel allowed in some countries. ... EMS, Airmail, and Surface cannot be used for the following countries: Germany, Italy, ... the United Kingdom ... (as of Oct 2025).
lithium_battery.noteEn: Batteries must be inside the device. Separate batteries and power banks are refused outright.

replica_gun.quoteEn: Model gun with bullets (cartridges) — Partial Disposal Required: Bullets cannot be shipped overseas and will be disposed of upon arrival at the warehouse. Opening Required.
replica_gun.noteEn: Real guns and gun parts are prohibited, but ZenMarket publishes a handling procedure for model guns rather than banning them. Disposal work is charged from ¥300, plus a handling fee from ¥1,000 per 15 minutes.

food.noteEn: That is the only food or drink entry in ZenMarket's prohibited list, and it is restricted to DHL. Because this tool prices EMS, such a purchase would not be shippable at all — but ordinary snacks are simply not covered by the published rules either way.

adult.quoteEn: Any illegal adult products, violence encouraging products etc
adult.noteEn: Only "illegal" adult products are named. Ordinary R18 material is not addressed, and "Any other items defined as inappropriate by ZenMarket" leaves the decision with them.

blade.quoteEn: Examples of products that cannot be shipped: guns, gunpowder, gun parts, any weapons
blade.noteEn: "Any weapons" is listed, but replica swords and iaito are not named either way.

perfume.quoteEn: For most countries, alcohol, alcoholic beverages, perfume containing alcohol etc.
perfume.noteEn: Listed under items prohibited by law from being sent by airmail. EMS is airmail.

cosmetics.noteEn: ZenMarket's prohibited list names flammable liquids, deodorant sprays and aroma sprays, but says nothing about skincare or make-up in general.

medicine.noteEn: ZenMarket refuses prescription medicine and illegal drugs, and says nothing about medicine sold over the counter.

plants_seeds.quoteEn: Examples of products that cannot be shipped: seeds, crops, mushrooms, bio-active substances.

flammable_liquid.quoteEn: Flammables substances and liquids: lighters, oils, paints, alcohols, engine parts, etc. ... Paint / Nail polish / Ink cartridges / Hair dyes

aerosol.quoteEn: Gas: gas stoves, spray cans, aerosols

lithium_battery.quoteEn: Only two batteries per package. Prohibited via Japan Post for: Algeria, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, El Salvador, Germany, Iraq, Italy, Kuwait, Moldova, Mongolia, Morocco, Norway, Portugal, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Spain, Thailand, and United Kingdom.
lithium_battery.noteEn: Nintendo Switch is FedEx-only except the Lite version, so it is not shippable on the EMS pricing this tool covers.

replica_gun.quoteEn: Airsoft replicas (gas and electric - airsoft batteries are also prohibited!)

lighter.quoteEn: Flammables substances and liquids: lighters, oils, paints, alcohols

food.quoteEn: PROHIBITED TO MEXICO / SPAIN / BELGIUM — Food and Drink Product (Chocolate, Dry snack, Tea, Coffee, Food Supplement, Etc.)
food.noteEn: Food is blocked only for Mexico, Spain and Belgium. None of the destinations this tool covers are on that list.

adult.quoteEn: CHINESE MAINLAND, HONG KONG, SAUDI ARABIA — Item related to pornography (Books, Video game, Figure, Bed sheets…)
adult.noteEn: Neokyo names Hong Kong specifically, so adult material cannot be sent there through them. Fine for the other destinations. Child sexual abuse material, and adult items depicting minors, are banned worldwide.

blade.quoteEn: Firearms and explosives: Katana blades, fireworks, weapon like items

perfume.noteEn: Listed under flammable substances and liquids.

cosmetics.quoteEn: Skincare products with ethanol concentrations exceeding 24%
cosmetics.noteEn: Neokyo also refuses sunscreen, shampoo and hair tonic. It refuses cosmetics in general only to Mexico and Spain.

_source.noteEn: Read from the full prohibited list on the official Cautionary Notes page, opened with its "Show more" control.

flammable_liquid.quoteEn: We cannot purchase or export items forbidden by law, dangerous items such as flammable substances and other restricted items.

aerosol.quoteEn: We are unable to ship dangerous goods for air transport outside of Japan. Such items can only be shipped within Japan.
aerosol.noteEn: Aerosols are not named individually, but they are dangerous goods for air transport, which FROM JAPAN states it cannot send abroad.

lithium_battery.quoteEn: Items with lithium batteries or lithium-ion batteries (limited to certain countries)
lithium_battery.noteEn: FROM JAPAN refuses them only for some countries and links to Japan Post's conditions, so Japan Post's rule for the destination decides.

replica_gun.noteEn: FROM JAPAN's full prohibited list also names air guns.

lighter.quoteEn: We are unable to ship dangerous goods for air transport outside of Japan. Such items can only be shipped within Japan.
lighter.noteEn: Lighters are not named individually, but they are dangerous goods for air transport, which FROM JAPAN states it cannot send abroad.

food.noteEn: The list also names meat products, fresh produce, raw milk and eggs. Shelf-stable snacks are not on it.

adult.quoteEn: Prohibited Items Banned or Regulated for Export by Japanese Law: Adult goods and pornography
adult.noteEn: FROM JAPAN is the only one of the four that bans adult material outright, for every destination.

perfume.noteEn: Listed under flammable liquids and substances.

cosmetics.quoteEn: Flammable items and items containing a flammable warning (e.g. sunscreen, shampoo, and adhesives)
cosmetics.noteEn: Ordinary skincare and make-up are not on FROM JAPAN's list; anything with a flammable warning is.

medicine.quoteEn: Category 1 pharmaceuticals and medical devices that require a license for sale in Japan (including contact lenses and fashion color contact lenses)
medicine.noteEn: Category 1 is the strictest class of medicine sold without a prescription in Japan. Other over-the-counter medicine is not on the list.

plants_seeds.noteEn: The list also names bonsai, decorative plants and items with soil.

flammable_liquid.quoteEn: Flammable materials and liquids, ping pong balls, fuels (such as gasoline and kerosene), matches, lighters, paints, perfumes/fragrances/aroma oils/essential oils, nail polish and nail polish remover, alcohol, thinner

aerosol.quoteEn: aerosol cans (such as hair sprays, deodorant sprays, spray paints, and pain relief sprays)

lithium_battery.quoteEn: Lithium Batteries — Must be installed inside the device; cannot be shipped separately (e.g., cameras, consoles, phones, tablets, computers). Max. 2 items with built-in lithium batteries per package.
lithium_battery.noteEn: Batteries must be inside the device, at most two such items per parcel. Power banks are refused.

replica_gun.quoteEn: Firearms (including model guns, air guns, pistols, rifles, machine guns, cannons, as well as their ammunition and firearm parts)

food.quoteEn: Refrigerated, frozen, and raw food items are also not supported, as Doorzo does not provide the necessary storage or shipping conditions for such products.
food.noteEn: Shelf-stable food is only listed as prohibited for parcels sent from Doorzo's Korean warehouse; from Japan, refrigerated, frozen and raw food is refused.

adult.quoteEn: Items with obscene content or adult products

blade.quoteEn: imitation knives, and all types of swords

perfume.noteEn: Perfume is also on Doorzo's list of common international prohibited items.

cosmetics.quoteEn: Items labeled with warnings such as "Keep Away from Fire" or similar indications.
cosmetics.noteEn: Doorzo also lists sunscreen and hair tonic. Cosmetics in general are refused only from its Korean warehouse.

medicine.quoteEn: Medicines and medical devices, such as contact lenses, massagers, and hearing aids, can only be sold by licensed professionals.
medicine.noteEn: Listed under Doorzo's prohibited item categories.

plants_seeds.quoteEn: Living organisms (including animals, plants, and insects), items containing soil, flowers, potted plants
plants_seeds.noteEn: The same entry names plant seeds.

lithium_battery.noteEn: Germany is absent from Japan Post's published list of countries that accept equipment containing lithium batteries by air. Japan Post will not take them by EMS, air mail or surface mail, so no proxy can send them on this route.

The United Kingdom is absent from Japan Post's published list of countries that accept equipment containing lithium batteries by air. Japan Post will not take them by EMS, air mail or surface mail, so no proxy can send them on this route.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for the United States by air when they are installed in the device. Proxies cap this at two batteries per parcel and refuse loose batteries and power banks.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for Canada by air when installed in the device. Two batteries per parcel, no loose cells or power banks.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for Australia by air when installed in the device. Two batteries per parcel, no loose cells or power banks. Surface mail is not available for batteries.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for France by air when installed in the device. Two batteries per parcel, no loose cells or power banks.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for Singapore by air when installed in the device. Two batteries per parcel, no loose cells or power banks. Surface mail is not available for batteries.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for Taiwan by air when they are installed in the device. Two batteries per parcel, no loose cells or power banks.
Japan Post accepts lithium batteries for Hong Kong by air when they are installed in the device. Two batteries per parcel, no loose cells or power banks.
